clinical_notes: chest x-rays of a 73-year-old male patient affected by covid-19 (a–d). the first chest radiograph at admission demonstrated bilateral pulmonary perihilar consolidations (a). due to a worsening of the clinical conditions, during the second day after admission, he underwent endotracheal intubation (b) with a significant improvement of the radiological findings within 24 h (c). 72 h later, the radiological findings worsened again especially in the left lung (d)
